content.comment_body: Hello, I need some assistance. I have a wind speed sensor with a 4-20mA output, and I want to control an inverter using a 10V signal. I am using a [product_name] [version_no] and an analog output module, but I'm unsure how to achieve a 10V output when the input is 4mA and decrease it to 0V when the input increases to 30mA. The goal is to lower the height of a fountain during strong winds. Thank you. [user_name]

To connect the wind sensor, place one side to the positive of the power supply—make sure it's the same DC supply as the [product_name]. Route the negative from the wind sensor to an analog input on the [product_name]. Add a 500 Ohm resistor between the analog input and the negative of the DC supply. This setup changes the 4-20mA signal to a 2-10V signal compatible with the basic [product_name]. The frequency output should connect to the 0-10V output of the analog output module. Note: The basic unit and any extensions need 24V DC power.
This solution worked perfectly, thank you!
